decisions.reason: As the successor standard to Universal Analytics, this plugin fits an ongoing market need and the firm's existing 2023 launch commitment gives management reasons to continue backing it.
Although sunk development effort may create some reluctance to exit, the product is tied to an obsolete Google Analytics standard and the weak strategic future makes withdrawal likely.
A retail system interface plugin is close to a German software consultancy's core integration business, so management is likely to persist with it unless clear evidence of failure emerges.

Because this service had its own dedicated webpage, the firm has made a relatively visible public commitment to it and is therefore likely to retain it and attribute any early weakness to temporary market factors.
